label: Simulation
tagline: Intuitive visualisation of real-world physical or temporal systems
description: Researches the right representation paradigm for a domain (2d-spatial-map / 3d-environment / iconographic-anim / hybrid) and orchestrates 7 component drawers + the 3 quality lenses to produce a lens-verified runnable simulation embedded as a canvas card. Runs 4-researcher fleet + synthesiser; user-steerage interrupt before any drawer fires; §8.3 loop-until-bar with 5-iteration cap; multi-draft at scene + loop cruxes via iterator-remix.

triggers.title: Path A — "build an app"
triggers.rule: User says "build a web app / dashboard / page that monitors X system" with app-framing words. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell first (with sim-placeholder slot), then dispatches simulation-planner per slot (Mode A envelope with slotFile/slotLine). After the planner returns the hand-off envelope, top-level Claude drives the build phase per simulation-planner.md §5.1.0 and embeds the runtime per §5.1.1.

triggers.title: Path B — Bare intent
triggers.rule: User says "model X for me / simulate Y / show me how Z works" with no app framing. Top-level Claude dispatches simulation-planner directly in BARE-INTENT MODE. Runtime IS the artefact; no app shell.
